children: Saudi Arabia’s Vision International Investment Company (Vision Invest) and Africa Finance Corporation (AFC) have committed to invest in Mauritius’ WIOCC Group.
The two entities signed a shareholder subscription agreement with the open-access digital infrastructure platform that operates across more than 30 African countries.
The two investors will make a combined $300 million investment in WIOCC, but the exact ownership share or size of investment from each party has not been disclosed.

The fresh capital will be used to scale the company’s operations across Africa through data centre deployment. The plan also involves expanding fibre networks and investing in new subsea cables, as demand for data, cloud and artificial intelligence grows.
Headquartered in Mauritius, WIOCC also operates hubs in Nairobi, Kenya and Johannesburg in South Africa.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria) seban.scaria@lseg.com

title: Saudi’s Vision Invest, Africa Finance Corp to invest $300mln in WIOCC Group
